accessibility.body: WCAG issues in the interface's code.

i18n.title: Translations

doc-drift.title: Documentation drift

tech-debt.body: Debt items found in the code, by cost.

context.noIndex: The project hasn't been indexed yet. Generate the index to see its services, infrastructure and conventions.
context.noBrain: No memories yet: the project's first build that learns something creates them.

tokens.title: My tokens on the server
tokens.summary: Your GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jira and Linear tokens, used for your own calls.
tokens.intro: The server keeps these tokens encrypted and uses them for your own forge and tracker calls. Once saved, a token is never shown again, on the phone or anywhere else.
tokens.removeBody: The server forgets it; calls that need it stop until you add one again.

invitations.title: Invitations

member.label: Member
